title: Does Over-Refusal Track Jailbreak Robustness? A Per-Model Pareto Audit

original_idea.body:
# Does Over-Refusal Track Jailbreak Robustness? A Per-Model Pareto Audit

**Problem:** For openly available models there is no simple side-by-side audit showing whether more jailbreak-robust models also over-refuse more.

**Direction:** Evaluate ~6 open models on a jailbreak suite (StrongREJECT subset) and an over-refusal suite (XSTest/OR-Bench subset), plotting each on a robustness-vs-over-refusal plane. Identify Pareto-dominated models.

**Why it matters:** A clean, reproducible Pareto audit of open models gives the community a comparison baseline for adaptive defenses without catastrophic over-refusal.

**Relevant context:** Deliberative Alignment (arXiv:2412.16339); XSTest; OR-Bench; StrongREJECT.
